graduation: the day you finish university and get your certificate
ceremony: a big, special event with many people
certificate: an official paper that shows you finished your studies
degree: what you get when you finish university
proud: very happy because of something good you or someone did
nervous: a little afraid before something important
celebrate: do something fun because of a happy day
tears: water that comes from your eyes when you cry
future: the time that comes after now
